title: Master the Z-Score: Building Mean-Reverting MQL5 Trading Systems
formula_and_logic: Z-Score is computed as (current_close - SMA_N) / std_dev_N, where SMA_N is the N-period simple moving average of closing prices, and std_dev_N is the population standard deviation (using divisor N, not N−1) over the same N periods. Entry_long triggers on a discrete cross: Z-Score was < InpLowerThresh on the prior closed bar and ≥ InpLowerThresh on the current closed bar. Entry_short triggers symmetrically: Z-Score was > InpUpperThresh on the prior closed bar and ≤ InpUpperThresh on the current closed bar. Exit_long occurs when Z-Score ≥ 0.0; exit_short when Z-Score ≤ 0.0. All calculations use only fully closed bars — no look-ahead or future data.
entry_long: Z-Score was < InpLowerThresh on previous closed bar AND Z-Score ≥ InpLowerThresh on current closed bar
entry_short: Z-Score was > InpUpperThresh on previous closed bar AND Z-Score ≤ InpUpperThresh on current closed bar
exit_rule: For long: Z-Score ≥ 0.0; for short: Z-Score ≤ 0.0

repaint.note: Z-Score is calculated exclusively on closed bars using rolling historical windows; no recalculation on incomplete bars or future data.

higher_tf.note: No higher time frame data is used; all calculations are on the current chart's timeframe.

tick_volume.note: Tick volume array is declared but unused in Z-Score calculation; only close[] is used.

Calculate the Simple Moving Average of the closing price over N periods: 2. Subtract the moving average from the current closing price and divide by the standard deviation:
Buy Setup: Z-Score crosses below -2.0 and then re-enters above -2.0. Exit when Z-Score crosses back to 0.0 (the mean).
Sell Setup: Z-Score crosses above +2.0 and then re-enters below +2.0. Exit when Z-Score returns to 0.0.

source_quotes.quote: Copies 2 readings from the indicator buffer starting at bar index 1 (the last fully closed candle)... Stores the Z-Score value of the most recently closed candle. Stores the Z-Score value of the candle right before that.
Exit when Z-Score crosses back to 0.0 (the mean).

summary: Статья описывает детерминированное торговое правило Strategy 1: Classic Mean Reversion, основанное на кроссах Z-Score через фиксированные пороги (±2.0 для входа, 0.0 для выхода), с полностью заданной формулой Z-Score и параметрами. Все условия проверяются строго по закрытым барам без заглядывания вперёд. Стратегия применима на спот-форексе и CFD (XAUUSD, US30, BTCUSD) на таймфреймах 15M и 4H.
